📖 How to use

  1. Click “New Test” to get a random paragraph, or just start typing.
  2. The 60-second timer starts automatically on your first keystroke.
  3. Type into the box — correct letters turn green, mistakes turn red as you go.
  4. When time runs out (or you finish the paragraph), you'll see your WPM score and accuracy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is WPM calculated?

One “word” counts as 5 characters. Your net WPM is (correct characters ÷ 5) ÷ minutes, so errors lower your score.

What is a good typing speed?

Around 40 WPM is average, 60+ is good, and 80+ is fast. Professional typists often exceed 100 WPM.

Can I cheat by pasting the text?

No — pasting is blocked in the typing box, so every score is genuinely typed.
